m41_jgsdf.name: M41 (JGSDF)
m41_jgsdf.authority: Main ruled the M41 family on 2026-10-29 (DECISIONS) on the owner's requests the same day ("lets make a m41, not chaffee", the original US tank and other countries', then "use our tank generation procedure on this m41 as the basis"): the JGSDF M41 at Japan's tier I, a photo-class mark of the M41A3's build judged on its markings, paint (Japan's Factory JGSDF olive) and stowage; no registered 3D comparison exists for this configuration. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
m41_jgsdf.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope of the shared M41 build, scaled once on the M41A3's registered print (SIpriv's "Low poly M41Walker Bulldog", CC-BY-4.0, measurement-only; the hull on the published 5.82 m): published 5.81 m hull, 8.21 m over the gun, 3.19 m wide, 2.72 m high (Jane's via Wikipedia). The envelope holds the fender stowage, the mirrors and the antenna whip. Japan received 130 (Wikipedia, Operators); the JGSDF mark keeps the US tank's form with the JGSDF coat, a radio box and canvas on the bustle rack. Wikimedia Commons holds no JGSDF M41 photograph; the US Army photograph of 1961 is the form reference.
